articles.title: AG&P Industrial and Pragati Infra Solutions Announce Joint Venture for India's First Advanced Modular EPC and Fabrication Manufacturing Facility; Sign MoU

This development will significantly boost India's domestic industrial capabilities, enabling advanced large-scale manufacturing. articles.title: Preetham Upadhya wins Chennai round of The Hindu businessline Cerebration Corporate Quiz 2026

articles.title: Military Kayaks in Special Operations: A Quiet Lineage
articles.summary: The use of kayaks and canoes in military operations boasts a history nearly as ancient as the crafts themselves. These agile vessels have long been instrumental for navigating complex inland and coastal waterways, offering discreet transit for various missions. Their enduring utility underscores their strategic importance for special operations, reconnaissance, and riverine warfare, making them valuable assets for defence forces.

articles.title: Man suspected of spying for Pakistan's ISI remanded to police custody in Jaipur
articles.summary: A 28-year-old individual, Jhabararam, accused of spying for Pakistan's ISI, has been remanded to four-day police custody by a Jaipur court. His arrest highlights ongoing national security threats and the critical importance of vigilance against foreign intelligence operations. This incident underscores the continuous efforts required in counter-intelligence to safeguard national interests and maintain internal security, a key area for aspiring defence personnel to understand.
